findings.highlight: liver, and all eight sections of my large intestine.
findings.evidenceJa: 肝臓胆嚢　大腸八器
findings.governingReading: The compressed bodily inventory explicitly includes the gallbladder after the liver.
findings.explanation: The English omits the gallbladder from the organ list. The surrounding account of extensive internal injury remains.

findings.highlight: tuck my head into my stomach
findings.evidenceJa: 頭を畳に押し付けたまま
findings.governingReading: 頭を畳に押し付けたまま maintains contact with the floor after the actual head impact in11.
findings.explanation: Head pressed to tatami becomes head tucked into his stomach.

findings.evidenceJa: 意識がボロボロと欠けた
findings.governingReading: 意識がボロボロと欠けた describes disintegrating consciousness after only slight loosening and shoulder exposure.
findings.explanation: Awareness fragmenting becomes a mental ordeal.

findings.evidenceJa: 意識がボロボロと欠けた
findings.governingReading: The Japanese sentence describes severe mental damage.
findings.explanation: Enough of mental ordeal lacks the required article.

findings.highlight: I can't remember how I was feeling just a second ago.
findings.evidenceJa: 一秒前に思いを馳せる、という方法が思い出せなかった
findings.governingReading: He cannot recall the METHOD of directing his thought one second backward, not merely the contents of a feeling.
findings.explanation: Forgetting how to look back one second becomes forgetting how he felt then.

findings.highlight: My useless head, that only knows how to help other people so much it's a nuisance
findings.evidenceJa: お節介なまでに人の手が入りまくった頭
findings.governingReading: 人の手が入りまくった頭 describes his mind having other people’s intervention throughout, echoing invasive/cooking reconstruction imagery.
findings.explanation: A head intrusively worked on by others becomes a head devoted to helping others.
